title: Dropout on an LSTM
summary: Where a mask may change across time, and where it must not.

choices.text: Draw a fresh mask on the hidden state at every time step, since independent noise across time is the strongest regularizer, and turn dropout off at test time with the usual scaling.
Leave the recurrent connection undropped, or reuse one mask across all time steps (variational dropout). Drop the non-recurrent connections as usual, and turn dropout off at test time.
Skip dropout: the forget gate already zeroes parts of the state at random during training, so it regularizes the same way and extra dropout only slows convergence.
Apply dropout to the cell state with a fresh mask at every step, because the cell state, not the hidden state, is where an LSTM overfits. Leave the inputs and outputs undropped.
